MUSIC AND DANCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.
   C. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
   D. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Instrumental Transpositions: (1 mark)

11. Best practice when working on Western Instruments: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)

   D. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)

14. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

15. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software..
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
